messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync request — BeaconHealth is in renewal next Tuesday and they flagged recent SLO misses (99th latency and 99.9% uptime). They want a clear breakdown of incidents, the credit calculation, and a short remediation pledge. Can we assemble a one-pager by EOD tomorrow?

aj_sales: Noted. They asked specifically how credits affect renewal concessions — want that called out separately. I'll be on the call Mon 10am PT.

tom_support: Pulling the month window now. Preliminary: measured uptime 99.87% for their account (us-west-2 primary). Three notable degradations. I'll paste timelines in a sec.

jess_ops: FYI our rollout on 2026-12-20 touched their canary pool — that caused a spike in tail latency while cache primed. We mitigated with throttled rollbacks.

svcs-bot: Incident report created: INC-20261203-dbfailover (root cause: managed DB failover), INC-20261213-cache-regen, INC-20261220-deploy-rollback. Links: https://infra.example.com/inc/INC-20261203

maria_cs: Tom — can you include per-incident duration and whether each counts toward SLO (customer-impacting vs non-customer-impacting)? Also we need the credit calculation spelled out, example math anchored to their typical monthly invoice.

tom_support: Copy. Quick summary I have so far:
- 2026-12-03 03:14 UTC — DB failover, 00:22:35 downtime, customer impact (all endpoints)
- 2026-12-13 17:40 UTC — cache regen, 00:45:12 partial degradation, high 99th latency (~1.2s) for some routes
- 2026-12-20 09:02 UTC — deploy rollback, 00:05:47 spike in errors, mitigated quickly
Measured uptime: 99.87% (SLO threshold: 99.9%).

jess_ops: For the cache regen, we pushed an accidental full-evict across the shared L2 layer for that customer. Ops change: namespace-scoped evict only. I can draft a 1-paragraph mitigation + timeline.

aj_sales: Please make the one-pager explicit that credits do not equal discount on renewal pricing but are invoice credits; include sample numbers so finance has clarity. BeaconHealth finance will want the exact amount.

maria_cs: Yes — sample numbers and the formula. Tom, can you compute credit w/ two examples: (a) if we apply the standard contract formula, and (b) a 'goodwill' round number that we recommend for renewal impact.

tom_support: Will do. Here is the standard contract credit calc (from SLA appendix):
```
if measured_uptime >= SLO: credit = $0
else: credit_pct = min(1.0, (SLO - measured_uptime) / SLO)
credit_amount = round(credit_pct * monthly_invoice, 2)
```
Example (BeaconHealth monthly invoice = $48,000):
Measured uptime 99.87% vs SLO 99.9% => delta = 0.03% => credit_pct = 0.000301 -> credit_amount = $14.45 (per formula)

tom_support: Which is tiny and awkward to present. Recommend a clear table + a proposed goodwill credit (rounding to $1,200) to show our commitment when discussing renewal.

aj_sales: +1 to the goodwill figure. Sales wants a clear justification paragraph for why we propose it (cost to customer, lost trust, exec motion). I'll own the negotiation language.

maria_cs: OK. Action items:
- tom_support: full incident timeline + raw metrics + the two credit calc examples (standard formula + proposed goodwill) — due EOD tomorrow.
- jess_ops: one-paragraph root-cause + mitigation steps and ops changelog we commit to; also test plan to prevent cache-evict blast — due EOD tomorrow.
- aj_sales: prepare renewal talking points that call out credits are invoice credits, not price reduction, include concession framing — due Mon before the call.

jess_ops: I'll also add a small alert rule change to detect large namespace evicts; will include PR link in the one-pager.

maria_cs: Thanks. I'll draft the one-pager template and share a first pass in this thread by 15:30 PT. Please add snippets/links to infra dashboards.

tom_support: Uploaded metrics snapshot and Grafana links: https://grafana.example.com/d/sku123/beacon-uptime. Also attaching raw CSV to the one-pager when I send it.

aj_sales: I'll prep the chartered concession amount and a short exec summary for the renewal deck.

maria_cs: Great. If anyone needs me to join the incident postmortem for phrasing, ping me. Thanks all :thumbsup:
